name: Blindness/Deafness

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Choose Blinded or Deafened for each targeted creature; CON save, end-of-turn repeat CON save; one-minute non-Concentration lifetime; higher slots add creatures.

rules.text: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
